summary: This tutorial provides a comprehensive walkthrough of the HyperFrames CLI visual-regression loop for seekable HTML motion, detailing commands like lint, check, snapshot, and keyframes. The submission is well-structured, supported by a real public repository (Apache-2.0), and provides practical CLI workflows for AI agents and developers.
strengths: Clear end-to-end tutorial covering the entire HyperFrames CLI quality gate loop.
Well-backed by a real, verifiable open-source repository with matching commits.
Detailed explanation of command behaviors, options, and failure modes.
Strong focus on agent-friendly development workflows.
weaknesses: Dense terminology can be overwhelming for beginners unfamiliar with HyperFrames core concepts.
Assumes prior familiarity with headless rendering caveats.
suggestions: Add a quick troubleshooting section for common headless Chrome or browser path failures.
Include a minimal runnable example file snippet for a `.motion.json` sidecar directly in the text.

claims.text: npx hyperframes lint reads HTML and does not boot Chrome.

novelty_vs_existing.title: A seek-adapter contract for mixed animation runtimes in HyperFrames
novelty_vs_existing.contribution: Focuses specifically on the CLI visual regression and validation loop rather than the internal adapter contract.
